posts.author: Post
posts.content_text:
How to make side mods work with the shipped Hoth map:
This was discovered by TK-8252 (see
http://www.secretsociety.com/forum/disp ... sp?mid=175
) but I thought it needed a bit more explanation.
When you replace the shipped Imperial side with a modded version, it will crash the Hoth: Echo Base map. This happens because the map requires a probot object. Although it isn't actually used in the map, it appears that they forgot to take it out completely. The imperial assets with the mod tools don't include an ODF for the probot, but you can easily make one yourself to fix this issue. It doesn't even need to be a functioning unit. You can just make it as a simple prop.
Create a text document and save it as imp_droid_probe.odf in the folder C:\LucasArts\BFBuilder\Assets\Sides\IMP\ODF
It needs to contain the following text:
[GameObjectClass]
ClassLabel  = "prop"
GeometryName    = "imp_droid_probe.msh"
[Properties]
GeometryName    = "imp_droid_probe"
That's all there is to it. Now every time you import the retail IMP side, it will be set up to work with the shipped Hoth map. You can also copy the ODF into an existing mod's side folder.

Hello Gametoast!
You remember me?
I'm posting this for three reasons:

I saw that some people have searched for my old maps in the forum and couldn't find all of them.
3.
There's some new stuff that you don't know yet!
New stuff?
Well, to be honest it's not completely new. 1-2 years ago I worked on improving my
Coruscant
and my
Tantive IV
maps, mostly regarding the sides' weapons. But there's also a new trooper in Coruscant, etc. ...
BUT
I also have to tell you that the Coruscant-changes have not reached a "final level". Some objects should've been reskinned, some new vehicle weapons should've been named properly... You'll find more little non-perfect spots. I tried to fix them but after a longer BF2 absence and the purchase of a new PC with Windows 8 system I couldn't work on those issues any longer without going crazy (Windows 8 always tries to kill you with a heart attack when you expect it the least...)
So I decided to release the latest (and I guess the last) versions of those two maps as "
Special Editions
". Cause I thought you'd really like them and for I'm a big old-school metal and hard rock fan I know what to do with unreleased material and approved old stuff: Release it as a special edition when the time is right!
And is the time actually right? I hope so. Modding and especially mapping was very importent for me in my later teenage years (I'm getting old!  :vader:
) and I learned a lot from it. Not only about codes and different kinds of files, image editing and stuff - but also about planning and design.
Maybe you want to know why I don't have time for working hard on my maps anymore. It's because I started studying what's called "Environment Planning and Architecture" in Germany at university. So I'm kind of working on "real life maps" now.
I hope that Gametoast and SWBF2 will live on (well, there won't be BF3 so people hopefully won't forget the most important version of that game!  :chew: )!

Anyway, it's sort of a sparse forest/grassy map.  The environment was half based off of The Old Republic's Hope trailer and half off of the ending to Revenge of the Sith.  Stock sides, default heroes, Clone Wars only.  I'm using THEWULFMAN's Battlefront Evolved 1.0 in the screenshots.
--------------------------------------------------
INSTALLATION:
Unzip Tatooine__Mos_Nytram.zip and place the SWG folder into your addon folder. Load up SWBF2 and enjoy!
--------------------------------------------------
Known Bugs:
-None so far.  Of course, let me know if there's a levitating tree or a bot trying to flee the battlefield and I'll get on it.
-The treebillboards facing away from the map was a mistake at first, but now I kinda prefer its look that way.

posts.author: Post by Eggman
posts.content_text: Wow, just glancing at the screenshots, the map looks very pretty. The color of the lighting looks just about perfect. I especially like the way you used the background mountains and treeline - they look like totally natural extensions of the world, which I always thought was kind of tough to achieve with dome objects.\nOne criticism/possible suggestion for the lighting: it looks like you have the directional lighting, top ambient lighting, and bottom ambient lighting all set to about the same color. My suggestion would be to keep the directional lighting that same nice pinkish color, but make the top ambient light more of a neutral white/light grey color, and the bottom ambient light a medium shade of grey. So the directional light = the color from the setting sun, the top ambient light = the general light from the daytime sky, and the bottom ambient light = a nice subtle shadowing effect. That's how I always set up the light in my maps, and I thought it created a more natural atmosphere.\nAll in all, nice work! I've always been a sucker for nice skies and lighting effects, and you've definitely impressed me in those regards!

posts.author: Noobasaurus
posts.content_text:
How well do YOU know the layout of SWBF2 maps?
Features:
- Era mod for many stock maps
- Different playable props for each map
- One seeker class
- Cool scripting things
- Everyone is semi-fast
- Seekers have jetpacks and machine guns
What is prop hunt?
Prop hunt is a gamemode in which one team is seekers and one team is props.  The props choose different objects to play as and they must go hide from the seekers.  After one minute, the seekers will be able to spawn.  The props' objective is to hide from the seekers for five minutes (starts when the first prop spawns).  The seekers' objective is to find and kill all of the props before time runs out.
Does that mean it is for multiplayer only?
Technically, yes.  It is still playable in singleplayer, but all you can do is run around as a prop for five minutes.  Singleplayer is only good for finding hiding spots.

GAB wrote:
AvalancheMaster wrote:
It's starting to look more like a Counter Strike map than a Battlefront one.
Why? (I never really played Counter Strike so I don't know what its maps look like)
There's a big difference in the objectives. In BF some locations on the map are more important than other, because it's where players actively spawn (command posts). In CS, you spawn only in the beginning of a round. You die--you stay dead for the duration of the round. Thus every location in potentially a strategic point. You managed to overcome this by having close-quarter indoor corridors (the houses) mixed with open-air warfare. Adding additional furniture and props only brings them to life even more, which makes the map more believable (and enjoyable).

posts.author: Post by Teancum
posts.content_text:
I have only three real pet peeves:
Maps that have custom units. Seriously. At this point there are more maps with someone's custom units (usually not very good ones) than there are with the stock ones. Unless you have a good reason for having custom units (such as your map being in a TV/comic/book location with a specific clone legion) consider using either stock sides *or* just adding era support for stuff like BFX.
Huge maps. There's a darn good reason the stock maps are the size they are. I don't want to be killed in the middle of a battle only to respawn at the furthest checkpoint with no vehicles nearby. Then I have to take like two minutes to get back to the battle
Maps with huge reinforcements. Again, there's a reason the numbers are small on the stock maps. I want 10-15 minutes of gameplay at a time. If I want more, I'll use the Fake Console in 1.3 to add reinforcements. I don't want to be forced into a 40 minute game.

posts.author: ZoomV
posts.content_text: To be honest I prefer ubermode for anything that isn't a overly compact map. Battlefront never had enough going on, and to me at least I find it very annoying to have maps where I can just Rambo the enemy line, leave all my friendly AI behind and just solo cap CPs. (read every stock map in the game)\nWar is chaotic and while I can understand why you don't want to emulate real battle conditions (dying because of bad luck leads to frustration) I feel like players should feel like they are running a gauntlet.\nI also like the high but reasonable reinforcement maps, because I honestly just enjoy running around shooting and don't like it when things end too quick.

I like:
Big Battles, as long as there's stuff to do everywhere.
Custom Units, if they're well balanced and done right. But they're not a requirement for a map.
Canon Accuracy
There being a reason to do stuff on the map, don't make a unit or vehicle completely pointless to use.
Good skins and models.
A proportionally correct amount of AI units. If the map is small, have a small unit count, if the map is large, have a large unit count.
Something new that hasn't already been done a million times.
Anything with Sereja's name on it.
I dislike:

Small maps with tons of units.
Visual inconsistency.
Overused planets, scenes and ideas. Do you know how many Geonosis maps there are?
Lack of localisation.
Tons of bugs.
Maps with useless classes and/or vehicles.
Heroes being available from the start in an infantry battle.

posts.author: Post by GAB

Here are some things that I personally think that can be big turn offs for players when it comes to modmaps:
- Too much walking to get to the action.
- Crappy AI (we know that SWBF2 AI isn't that great but they aren't that dumb either).
- Bad object placement.
- Lack of balance (Impossible to win with one team and guaranteed victory for the other team)
- Excessive amount of AI units.
And finally:
- Lack of proper work on lighting (It is through light that we see all the things. The way your map will look is directly proportional to the quality of the work you've done on lighting)
BONUS: things I personally think that can make a good map great:
- Some smart sound touches
- Use of those odf flares (They can make a map look really cool if used inteligently)
- Use of well made models.
- Foliage
- Animations (The ones done in Zero Editor)
- Attention to the smallest details.
- And lots of creativity.

posts.author: Marth8880
posts.content_text:
You know what kind of mods I really *hate*? Total conversion mods, especially and specifically those that are based on Mass Effect. :u
Nah but seriously though...
Dislike:
- Lack of polish
- Lack of proper sound design, but ESPECIALLY lack of AT LEAST an ambient sound stream (seriously, there's almost zero excuse to not have one, especially since you can just load a stock one)
- Lack of loadscreen
- Lack of decent level design (no "magic"/"wow" moments; also, every level should appeal to and include paths for all play-styles such as assault, sniping/stealth, and support/tank-busting [the latter of which could be paired with assault])
- Lack of lighting (why is this still such a common issue, like really, it's SO easy, especially when you can just copy over any stock map's main LGT file and rename it to your map's ID)
- Lack of planning/barriers/hintnodes (there is literally no excuse for this unless somehow creating these things is not possible in your case)
Like:
- Polish and attention to detail
- Scripted events that add to the experience rather than detract from it
- Well-thought-out level design that makes sense and makes me want to come back for more
- I don't care what kind of sides a map has as long as it's fun (though Clone Legion X is still pretty annoying to see *constantly*)
- Great lighting and terrain shading
Love:
- Proper sound design (if you want me to love your map, this is absolutely 100% necessary, even if it's just including an ambient sound stream
)
- Completely modular levels (with maybe a little terrain if it works)
- HD textures (this is 2015, so there isn't much of an excuse not to have this in your custom textures; and yes, Battlefront II is old, but it can handle it perfectly fine, as per every single thing I've ever put out for this game :u [but probably don't go over 1024x1024 unless it's a skydome or terrain texture or something like that])
- Smart use of Battlefront II's material system (normal maps aren't hard to generate thanks to tools like GIMP's normalmap plugin [
https://code.google.com/p/gimp-normalmap/
] and a nifty little app called CrazyBump [
http://www.crazybump.com/
]; also environment maps are nice to see every now and then; and I've found that models are shaded better when their materials' ambient color is set to 0,0,0)
- Custom, well-done models
- Smart use of hintnodes (Battlefront II's AI is awful, so we'd might as well at least try to *pretend* it's decent, eh?)

posts.author: thelegend
posts.content_text:
Tatooine At War [1.1] - Final Version
Tatooine At War is a total conversion map which combines many places seen on Tatooine such as Mos Eisley or Jabba's Palaces into on, large map.
There are many places you have probably seen from Episode IV to Episode VI. You can play as Boba Fett, Han Solo, Darth Vader or as Luke Skywalker in Conquest Mode, race against the time across the entire map or survive as a stranded Rebel Soldier in the middle of nowhere.
This map also supports Stock GCW (Just the units) so you can play this map with varios side mods (all.lvl + imp.lvl only).
Most assets were stock or self-made, some were made by other mod-authors and some other are assets from the cancelled game: Star Wars Battlefront III by Free Radical Design like Vehicles, Units and Weapons.

title: A Very Large SWBF2 Map List
author: Jaspo

posts.author: Jaspo
posts.content_text:
Hello, Gametoast! I present you with a full list of all the SWBF2 maps I have, in the form of a downloadable .txt file...I was hoping to make a nice pretty post on here instead, but it exceeded the post character limit (it's a big list). I put the file on my personal website, so I hope it doesn't give you all sorts of "untrusted website" warnings or anything when you download it.
link:
http://www.jasongieskedesign.com/Jaspo_ ... aplist.txt
Reminder: If you're looking for something specific, you can use the "Find" function in whatever program you're using, even web browsers.
In total, there are:
- 10 full/1 incomplete addon folders of maps
- 2 full/1 incomplete addon folders of beta maps
- 1 full/1 incomplete folder of map packs
- 6 other incomplete addon folders with specific content;
"BFX, Maveritchell's Dark Times II, KotOR sides, Mav's other maps, related maps" (this one's very nearly a full folder)
"contest entries"
"Conversion Pack 2_2, KotOR Galactic Conquest"
"Jaspo's Battlefronts Galactic Conquest (with Marvel4's BF1 Conversion Pack)"
"Jaspo's Extended Galactic Conquest"
"Jaspo's most up-to-date maps"
So, if there's a map on here that you can't find elsewhere, PM me and I'll upload it to mediafire or to my website for you.
History:
Back when the first rumors of swbffiles' imminent demise began swirling around, a number of modders endeavored to attempt to move the entire site's content here to Gametoast. It was in the end a rather unsuccessful effort, but in the process I downloaded the entire contents of the site, and have had them sitting around in a rather disorganized fashion since sometime in 2009.
Since then, I've been adding to the collection with maps from here there and everywhere (mostly from gametoast, some from gamefront, some from who knows where) and, sometime around 2013, I began organizing them into full addon folders. About 2 years ago I temporarily abandoned the project because I got a Steam account and got all distracted. But now, I've come back and completed it...not to say I've got every map ever made; I know I don't, but its complete in that everything I have ever downloaded is now on the list and assigned to a folder.
Edit: Here are the addon folders which are featured on the map list above, uploaded in ultracompressed form.
I see that people are making suggestions below for maps I've left out; I'll gather them all together and at some point in the distant future add them the folders in the collection which aren't yet full, and reupload them.
https://www.mediafire.com/folder/c1cdpn ... collection
They're in .7z format so you'll need 7zip to unpack them.
Update 8/27/18:
I discovered that Steam is blacklisting Mediafire due to some malware in some of the popup ads, so I moved everything to Google Drive and made a Steam guide with new download links, here:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/ ... 1493175096

Jaspo wrote:
Hello, Gametoast! I present you with a full list of all the SWBF2 maps I have, in the form of a downloadable .txt file...I was hoping to make a nice pretty post on here instead, but it exceeded the post character limit (it's a big list). I put the file on my personal website, so I hope it doesn't give you all sorts of "untrusted website" warnings or anything when you download it.
link:
http://www.jasongieskedesign.com/Jaspo_ ... aplist.txt
Reminder: If you're looking for something specific, you can use the "Find" function in whatever program you're using, even web browsers.
In total, there are:
- 10 full/1 incomplete addon folders of maps
- 2 full/1 incomplete addon folders of beta maps
- 1 full/1 incomplete folder of map packs
- 6 other incomplete addon folders with specific content;
"BFX, Maveritchell's Dark Times II, KotOR sides, Mav's other maps, related maps" (this one's very nearly a full folder)
"contest entries"
"Conversion Pack 2_2, KotOR Galactic Conquest"
"Jaspo's Battlefronts Galactic Conquest (with Marvel4's BF1 Conversion Pack)"
"Jaspo's Extended Galactic Conquest"
"Jaspo's most up-to-date maps"
So, if there's a map on here that you can't find elsewhere, PM me and I'll upload it to mediafire or to my website for you.
History:
Back when the first rumors of swbffiles' imminent demise began swirling around, a number of modders endeavored to attempt to move the entire site's content here to Gametoast. It was in the end a rather unsuccessful effort, but in the process I downloaded the entire contents of the site, and have had them sitting around in a rather disorganized fashion since sometime in 2009.
Since then, I've been adding to the collection with maps from here there and everywhere (mostly from gametoast, some from gamefront, some from who knows where) and, sometime around 2013, I began organizing them into full addon folders. About 2 years ago I temporarily abandoned the project because I got a Steam account and got all distracted. But now, I've come back and completed it...not to say I've got every map ever made; I know I don't, but its complete in that everything I have ever downloaded is now on the list and assigned to a folder.
Edit: Here are the addon folders which are featured on the map list above, uploaded in ultracompressed form.
I see that people are making suggestions below for maps I've left out; I'll gather them all together and at some point in the distant future add them the folders in the collection which aren't yet full, and reupload them.
https://www.mediafire.com/folder/c1cdpn ... collection
They're in .7z format so you'll need 7zip to unpack them.
You I hearby call you everyone's savior.
As some people already mentioned and I'll be one of those people as well, some mods do put stuff into the actual data folder rather than the addon folder. For the special addon folders with that, make sure you include the data folder with the special modifications. Also it looks like you don't have the Dark Space Map Pack with Last Days and requires the Dark Times mod for the era to work.
http://www.mediafire.com/download/ml702 ... ds/FAI.exe
in case you start looking for it.
Also, there are some maps on that list that are compatible with mods like conversion pack Kotor, Dark Times, BFX, BF0, Ultimate Battlefront, and other mods. You should make another addon folder(s) or just a list of maps compatible with one or more of these major mods or any other major mod I did not mention.
I'll edit this post if I dig up any maps that I have or have found that you don't have that are good. Also I think you should opt out listing the default maps for each addon folder.

posts.author: Post by AnthonyBF2
posts.content_text:
This is an update to the first one I made, which was a bit sloppy. I said an update would come earlier but I lost my source files and had to rebuild everything again, along with what's new. The mod adds a bunch more options to the Fake Console menu. You'll be needing 1.3 patch in order to use this. I personally recommend the latest version, being 1.3 r129.
The first mod was just an excessively long list of commands and scrolling through the menu was a hassle because most commands were only useful in certain maps.
In version 2 the main changes are that only the commands that are available to do something in a map are presented in that map. Example, in Death Star, you'll only see a small group of commands that can manipulate things in Death Star.
There will still be a good chunk of global commands that will appear in all maps/modes/mods. The map-specific commands will be listed under the global commands.
In version 2 I've implemented more "Ask User" functions that allow the user to input a value to manipulate something in the game. These are part of the global commands and can be used in stock maps or mod maps.
There a total of 5 new ask user functions, they are the first 5 listed under the main command section. One of the ask user functions is a primary weapon slot changer, but this doesn't work well. I kept it just because I thought it was cool. It allows you type the name of a weapon and it gets applied as all units as their current weapon. Game crashes a lot using this.

posts.content_text:
Hey,
i'm not sure if this is the right section, but it is WIP and i hope it's about 50% done.
So what is it about?
You may already know that i'm working on an own mesh viewer since the functions of the old one is really limited and there are functions i don't like or i miss.
What is the different to the old MeshViewer?
I don't know what language was used for the old one, but i'm using C++ with OpenGL. The benefit of OpenGL is, that it can be used as game engine, so it's also possible to display render flags, such as bump maps or animations.
Wait, we can view all animations on every unit with this viewer??
Actually it is possible to do this. But i will first concentrate on the basics. Display all mesh correctly.
How can i help?
At the moment i'm working on the basics, but i plan to enable addon support. So you can write your own functions for this viewer. For example addon hex editing.
What is done, what need to be done?
I learned about OpenGL and i already can read in tga files and the mesh file. But at the moment it's limited to triangulated mesh with only one model and texture.
I want to test this awesome project!
I hosted the whole project on gitlab:
https://git.rwth-aachen.de/carstenf/OpenGL/tree/master
The 3D Viewer was just for testing OpenGL. If you know how to program you can need to import the MeshViewer Project. It's a Visual Studio 2015 Project.
If you just want to test whether the project is running on your system or not, just download the release folder and run the exe.
If the viewer is not running on your system, please let me know the error message and your system information.
Any help or suggestions are always welcome.
EDIT
i wonder whether the OpenGL project works for you, since i worked on a different pc today and it didn't because there was only OpenGL 2.1 :-/
So please check the release thread:
https://git.rwth-aachen.de/carstenf/OpenGL
How to build the latest version by your own from the source:
================UPDATE================
Go and and download the updater from the release thread.
=====================================
Hidden/Spoiler:
go to
https://git-scm.com/download
and download git for your system. On my test system i'll use Windows 32 bit.
i use the default settings
all right, now get qt at
https://www.qt.io/download-open-source/
. Skip the Qt Account window and choose these settings
now you make a new emty qt project. Go to File>new. Choose other projects>empty qmake-project
and save it somewhere on your harddrive. I'll choose C:/Users/Anakin/workspace/
name your project QtMeshViewer
and klick next until you are done.
open QtMeshViewer.pro and add this:
[code]
QT          += core gui opengl
CONFIG += c++11
LIBS += -lopengl32
greaterThan(QT_MAJOR_VERSION, 4): QT += widgets
TARGET = QtMeshViewer
TEMPLATE = app
[/code]
================UPDATE================
Place the .bat file at
C:\Users\Anakin\workspace (remember your path here)
run the exe with the parameter src the first time.
Skip everything between the "===" lines
=====================================
now open a command promt (cmd) and enter the following lines
cd C:\Users\Anakin\workspace (remember your path here)
git init
git remote add origin -f
https://git.rwth-aachen.de/carstenf/OpenGL.git
git config core.sparsecheckout true
echo QtMeshViewer/*> .git/info/sparse-checkout
git pull origin master
=====================================
now you go back to Qt Creator, right klick on the project>add existing file (you need to do it multiple times) and choose:
../QtMeshViewer/main.cpp
../QtMeshViewer/Source/* (you can choose all of them at once)
../QtMeshViewer/Header/*
../QtMeshViewer/Form Files/*
../QtMeshViewer/Resources/Resources.qrc
Now you need to go back to the .pro file and change this
[code]
FORMS += \nForm Files/FileInfoWindow.ui \nForm Files/MainWindow.ui \nForm Files/SettingsWindow.ui
[/code]
to this
[code]
FORMS += \n"Form Files/FileInfoWindow.ui" \n"Form Files/MainWindow.ui" \n"Form Files/SettingsWindow.ui"
[/code]
finaly press the green run button in the lower left corner.
================UPDATE================
to get the latest build just run the updater. No need to pass
src to it again. You can just double klick it.
=====================================
If you want to get the latest build, go to your console, browse your location and repeat the last command
git pull origin master
=====================================
If i add any new files you need to add them to the project like you did above

posts.author: kiprobin
posts.content_text:
The swamp planet Mimban has decided to resist Imperial conquest and now faces the might of the Imperial Army and the 224th Imperial Armored Division. Unbeknownst to the Empire, however, the Mimbanese Liberation Army has recruited the assistance of the Rebel Alliance. Faced with an embarrassing defeat, theEmpire must hold its ground until reinforcements arrive to push back the insurrectionists.
Welcome to this, my fifth map in my Trench War map series. This time we travel to Mimban, the trench ridden battlefield seen in Solo: a Star Wars Story. As far as I know, it is the first time someone has attempted it in SWBF2. Gameplay vid: [youtube]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=noF38ubi83s
[/youtube]
download link:
https://www.moddb.com/mods/trench-war/a ... al-defense
After this I'm going to update Lothal using my new found side editing skills, as well as some other stuff. After that, you get to decide what's next. Below is a link to a google poll where you can vote on what map you want to see. The choices are Lah'mu, Thule, and Jedha.
Google poll:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1SF1ozy ... 1nBvo/edit
Key features:
-Custom Sides (yes yes yes I know the swamptroopers don't look movie accurate but it's my first time side editing ok?), including custom units, weapons, and some sounds
-Custom Vehicles
-Play as swamptrooper Han fighting on behalf of the Empire, or as the Mimbanese Liberation Army and the liberated Chewbacca opposing them
Known bugs:
-some flickering objects, including athaulers. most likely due to high object count, so no much i can do
-there are still floating weapon icons for the rebels side. I fixed them for the empire, but it didnt work for rebels. maybe I'll go back and fix later, maybe not, idk)
-ywing turret sounds as always
-if you spawn in at the kwing, you sometimes get trapped under the wing. you can easily escape by entering then exiting the kwing, and while the ai will get stuck there for a while, they'll eventually escape unharmed when the kwing takes off
-some ai, especially imperials, sometimes just stand there and do nothing. i tried optimizing planning, to no avail, but rest assured that there are still plenty of active ai for an intense battle
-based on the feedback i received from Lothal, i suspect this doesnt work with Harrisonfog's side mod. I havent tested it, but i would be very surprised if it didnt cause a crash
As always, I will release all the custom assets that I personally made later on today. Also, the credits are quite long this time, so if by chance I missed someone, please let me know so I can immediately fix it

EDIT: Link is now LIVE! Download Absolute War Galactic Conquest on 13th February at 20:00 GMT:
https://www.moddb.com/games/star-wars-b ... c-conquest
Hi All,
After about 10 months of work, on and off, I'm very nearly ready to release my Galactic Conquests: Absolute Galactic Civil War & Absolute Imperial War! As the names suggest, they are matching conquests, one where you can play as the Rebels and one as the Empire (akin to Jaspo's Extended Galactic Conquest). These are the first of a series of Galactic Conquests that I have been working on, there will be more to follow.
I should be ready to release them in the next couple days, right now I'm just doing a few final tweaks to get everything perfect. I could use some help on this too (more on that later). Currently, here are a few highlights:
* Includes 38 unique planets, only 11 of which are stock planets
* Each planet location is correct based on SWGalaxyMap.com
* Includes 48 maps, including the 3 space maps and 9 stock maps
* Each planet has a unique camera zoom effect
* The Yavin model that plagues most custom galactic conquests has been fixed
* Disabled the enemy team from buying bonuses that will have no effect on them
* Dantooine, Rhen Var and Yavin all have multiple map options
I've tried to make these Galactic Conquests as professional looking as possible. I'm about 95% of the way there to that goal, but I could use a little help getting me over the line:
* Firstly, as I said above, I'm working on a number of Galactic Conquests at the moment, which will be released over the next few months or so. As a result, I'm going to run out of gc_## between 1-11 very quickly, especially as I'm avoiding using 3&4 (used by EGC), 5&6 (KoToR) and 11 (Dark Times). Currently, I'm using 7&8. With the current v1.3 patch, I can go above 11, but only with consecutive numbers, and as I'm sure many of you are aware, there's a bug in [RDH]Zerted's code which means only 1 works at a time. If anyone has a fix for this, I'd be grateful to know it please. I believe Anakin's Remastered has a fix, and while I haven't tried it yet I believe you have to have Remastered installed for it to work (if I'm wrong I'd like to know).
* Secondly, I'd quite like to retexture the different planets to give them a truly unique look. I've used every lighting and camera position trick I can think of to make them all look fairly unique , but I know it could be a bit better. If anyone is able to help me out with this, please help!
They're both things I can get away without for now, so I will publish without these fixes for now, but it's something I'm keen to do soon.
To make my Absolute War GCs, I've used what I think are some of the best mod maps out there to make it (I'd like to stress here that none of them belong to me, and all creators will be credited fully). To differentiate it, I've tried not to use many of the maps in Jaspo's EGC, though there are a couple of crossovers because I couldn't resist. I've also not restricted myself to only include real planets in the Star Wars universe, allowing me to include some brilliant maps like Kothlis and Pharosis.
Today, I have uploaded every mod map which will be required for these galactic conquests which ARE NOT ALREADY ON MODDB. Many of these are very old mods that can be very hard to find online these days. I have done this purely to spread the joy of these maps to a potential new audience, and to make it easier for downloads for my GC (now every map is on Moddb). All original creators have been credited, I take no credit in them at all. These have been uploaded
here
.

Clone Wars Era Heroes are TCW Anakin and TCW Asajj Ventress.
Galactic Civil War Era heroes are Darth Vader and General Lando Calrissian.
INSTALLATION
Installing the MGS mod is the same process as every other SWBF2 mod.
Move the folder "MGS" to your Addon folder, or create the folder in the GameData folder if it does not already exist.
TIPS
The Death trooper's E-11D is a charge up weapon so if you hold down the fire button and then release it, you get a bigger damage hit.
I suggest you put on the expanded soundtrack of this episode on youtube whilst you play for a better playing experience.
PROBLEMS
Collision issues near the bridge stairs- sometimes units get out of the map, not sure how they do it, I can't replicate it.
Other Collision issues such as units getting out of the map, not sure how they do it, I can't replicate it.
Flickering Health/ Gonk droids.
NOTES
The Mandalorian is inaccurate to the episode, he should have a kneepad on but I didn't want to add that. He should also have an insignia on his right shoulderpad but I didn't add that.
Also appearing in that episode are Sandy Stormtroopers and imperial officers- I didn't include them.
The Tie Mauler is sourced from the EU but we never see the left hand side of the Warehouse in the episode so it could have been there.

posts.author: Lokgroa
posts.content_text:
This map is based on The Mandalorian Season 1 Episode 4: Sanctuary. You can play in the Mandalorian Era or classic eras.
Content
This map is based on The Mandalorian Season 1 Episode 4: Sanctuary.
3 Conquest modes- Clone Wars, Galactic Civil War, The Mandalorian Era
3 2 flag CTF modes- Clone Wars, Galactic Civil War, The Mandalorian Era
3 1 flag CTF modes- Clone Wars, Galactic Civil War, The Mandalorian Era
Mandalorian Era Teams
Sorgan Villager Gunner
Sorgan Villager Defender
Sorgan Villager Spearman
The Mandalorian
Cara Dune
Klatooinian Raider
Klatooinian Raider Captain
Weapons
DE-10 Pistol
Relby v10 Rifle
Spear
IB-94 Pistol
Amban Disruptor Sniper Rifle
Drum Rifle
Raider Fork
Raider Shotgun
For the CW Era the heroes are Saesee Tiin and Count Dooku.
For the GCW Era the heroes are Wedge Antilles and Iden Versio.
INSTALLATION
Installing the SOR mod is the same process as every other SWBF2 mod.
Move the folder "SOR" to your Addon folder, or create the folder in the GameData folder if it does not already exist.
I suggest you put on the expanded soundtrack of this episode on youtube whilst you play for a better playing experience.
CREDITS
Although I made the map, this mod would NOT have been possible without the support of the Gametoast forums and discord server. For that I am grateful.
BUGS
Please report bugs on the MODDB page. The E Webb is not bugged, it works as intended, don't report that.

posts.content_text:
JK514 wrote:
Teancum
Offtopic: Is it possible - converting vehicles from other games (mods for games)?
JK514,
I have seen it done with maps from SWBF1 it really depends on what model and which game. You have to keep in mind that we have to abide by U.S. copyright law here in this forum. We are also subject to the EULA as per the game. You should take some time and read the EULA that came with your game so you will understand what can or cannot be done. The models I have seen converted were from much older games. You should consider doing a web search for 3d models first to see if someone has already made the model you are looking for. There are many sites on the web that have Star Wars 3d models you just need to make sure the model has a low enough poly count to work in SWBF1 or 2.

posts.author: Post
posts.content_text:
I have SEVERAL suggestions for your map, most of which, I don't know if you can, or wish to fix or add in, but nonetheless, in my humble opinion I will believe they would enhance your map drastically to fit the Battle of Geonosis.
I will list them in this order.
Gameplay, Visual, and sound.
First the gameplay.
-Reorient the AT-TEs in a succesive pattern from left to right, and facing the battlefield, perhaps put one to the left of the command centre near the ARC-170s and create a pathway for the AI to follow, to engage the Spider Walkers that take the route around the destroyed CIS Ship. As it currently stands you have them in such a way they get stuck on each other constantly, and a simple movement of these walker may fix that problem.
-Remove the CIS Strike Bombers and ARC-170s from the ground. I do not know the intention of your map, multiplayer, LAN, or singleplayer, but as it stands both the ARC-170s, and CIS Bombers both are very much over powered for this map. The CIS Strike Bomber can literally kill DOZENS of troops in a single bombing run, while the ARC-170s either get in the way of the troops, crash immediately after take off, or do take off but then cease to do anything to actually help. The LAAT Gunship is fine as it is due to the accuracy of its laser guns, and its torpedos. And no, I am not saying remove all the ARC-170s and CIS Strike Bombers from the map, just to remove the ones on the ground.
-The crashed and destroyed AT-TEs, and LAAT Gunships are a either scattered to much to not be worth any significant value in the map, or put into such a small area with so many, that the they just clog the entire flow of the battle up, and block the very large Spider Walkers and AT-TEs from actually being able to push through. I suggest removing or moving the ones directly around the CIS bases (they're directly in the pathway of the Spider walkers and they constantly get caught on them as do the troops).
-The Droid CIS Flagship should be removed entirely, and the Droid Control Ship should be put in its place as the main starship for the CIS. This isn't that much of a detriment to gameplay, but it is VERY WEIRD to be seeing that long cynlidrical object of a CIS Capital Ship sitting above the Republic's base, especially it being the Clone Wars, and not ROTS. O_o
-The list of selectable classes is slightly screwed. As it is, there is a small "List of Profiles" bar at the bottom of the screen. Which is neither selectable, and cannot be seen in its entirety, in any resoution. I don't know if you can remedy that though. :/
-The Republic seems to be full of idiots. I have noticed that if I do not play as the Republic, they seem to lose VERY QUICKLY, and after a while will not even take bases, and their only counter for this loss is the large numbers they have at each base, who are, sitting on their asses.
UPDATE: After playing it a bit more, the Republic being full of idiots is not the case, apparently, somehow this was rectified with 1.5
But once again this is probably more a problem with BFII and its ridiculous AI coding then your map.
-Reorganization of nearly all land vehicles. Now this is the most glaring problem of the map that I at first noticed. The organization of the ground based vehicles and air vehicles is either far to sporadic, or disorganized, or completely half-assed in general. The AT-TEs do not need mention, the LAAT Gunships, could or be moved behind the AT-TEs, and the air vheicles (excluding the LAAT) could be removed, or moved entirely from their current positions, and especially the CIS bombers, because the troops and Spider Walkers are once again constantly getting hitched on them.
-No death zone for flying outside of the map edge. I realize you removed this from the map because of the addition of air vehicles require dogfighting space, but I could literally drive a AT-TE right out side of the map if I wanted.
-Now this is another little problem I have with the map, the battle of Geonosis, just had Droid Starfighters, Jedi Starfighters, the LAAT Gunships and the Geonosian Starfighter.
-Far to many capital ships. Maybe 2-3, but there's five, that's quite a few polygons that could be used elsewhere and performence could be increaseed (like mine
) on slower machines. Three of the ships are completely unusable, the two CIS droid Control ships do not have ANY hangers or CPs, and the the Republic's Cruiser is beyond the range of the flight ceiling for all of the starships.
-Another thing that irks me about the battle is the walkers you just recently put in. I think the Republic's hovertanks, or even the SPHA-T (don't think there's a model of it though, let alone being it animated, textured, and working
) would've been a better choice in my opinion.
-Mini-map in the spawn menu/mini-map is offset, the CP, soldiers, and practically everything else appear completely off from their actual positions on the visual map.
Other then that, gameplay is great, and really makes it seem like a gigantic battle whether then a small skirmish ESPECIALLY with the latest 1.5 version. My god, XL mode is nothing compared to what you made!
Now visuals.
-Lighting, I don't know what exactly is wrong with the lighting, but there is definitely a problem with it. The shadows, background quality, and lighting all seem different to one another, and it just does not feel like a arid, hot, and hostile environment. The lighting from the unmodified version of Geonosis in BFII feels much better. I don't know if you can fix this one, although I am sure you can, and in my opinion I believe it would add to your map's atmosphere greatly.
-Dust. Where is it?
But seriously, where is it? Geonosis is dusty, possiblely so dusty that not even billions of cans of Pledge could wipe it clean. Oh, and windy!
-The 2D Dogfighting LAATS and Droid Fighters field needs to be moved a bit, they kind of 'collide' (disappear) with the capital ships, and it throws the whole maps feel for a loop, but please don't take it out, it's an awesome visual especially when you start getting the actually LAAT and fighters battling.
-In some instances, and this is of course to be expected due to the size of the map, and battle, the sprite limit is reached. This is most likely unfixable, unless you removed some things. And we wouldn't want that now.
-The map is title 'Diet Dr. Pepper' in the list of maps in Instant Action. Along with a description that says 'Diet Dr. Pepper!'. Might want to fix that.
Other then that, everything is fantastic.
Now on to sound.
-There is no music while battling, UNLESS I play as a hero, such as Dooku, and General Grieveous.
-Sounds for all air vehicles do not work, or are not present.
And these are pretty much the only problems I see with your map, other then some tweaking for gameplay balances, and some more polish, I think you could have one of the best maps, Battlefront has ever known.
Oh, and sorry if this all has been stated before, I jsut didn't feel like reading through 19 pages of replies.

About those little astromech droids. They are gone now. For some reason they were responsible for the multiplayer crashes. Once I removed them the multi-player started working again.
No hero combination will please everyone...but what Ive done is removed grievous and kiya and replaced them with Jango and Mace. Really no sense in a "earned" hero on this map anyway with so many included heros on the field. This maxes out the linup. The locals are problematic on multi-player as well..thats why they all appear as playable.
You have to understand..this map now pushes the limits of the game engine and the efficient use of hardware..so I have some limits to work around now.  Cant add more Cap ships...most computers couldnt handle the VRAM load while trying to deal with all those AI.
Also added droidfighters at the hangars, and jedistarfighters...changed the spawn areas of most of the vehicles...and fixed it so they all head to the center to fight instead of tripping over themsleves. Generally polished the whole setup a bit. Captial ships are in the sky now in a cloud cover away from the ground  and repositioned. This release will be much more polished up.

posts.author: Post
posts.content_text: Have you been using their portal/sector system to section areas off to reduce lag? A lot of the custom Ut2004 maps I've played or worked on myself had a much larger budget but through zoning (or anti-portals), it lets you put in as much detail as you like. I'm unsure how polished this engines version of that is, but you could put portals up to occlude everything going on such as up on the hill where that cp is and the acklay. Or at the cap ships hanger doors themselves, tunnels, middle cp mesh etc.\nDistance fog too or "dust" so the graphics engine would ignore anything completely hidden even partially would help. Some engines also have a terrain sector size function for terrian optimization but I didn't see that in this editor.\nI'm sure you read up on all this with the documentation included with the editor, I just remember on that one amazing map Delinquent did (raxas prime), it didn't seem like he had placed any portals up yet, and if I remember right he had stated that he didn't know how to at the time, and was just pushing the graphical element.

My two cents?  Color fill the terrain with a bit more orange to match the spires.  If your terrain is to dark, try this trick:

2-Set all values to 255
3-Hit 'image', 'burn terrain'
4-Replace all of the 255s with your original values.

This map IS very video-intensive. Your system really needs to be up to date to play it.

posts.author: Post
posts.content_text:
The unit count is set to only one of each known person(i.e. Anakin..Obi-wan..etc)  The side your playing on, the computer thinks you might want to be another hero..so it saves that slot open unless it absolutely needs it.
The result is the enemy side(in single player) always employs all heros...and the side your on(either cis or rep) it holds back on filling that slot(unless it cant fill any other).  Any other workaround(setting the max to 2 instead of one) usually produces double-heros.
So, your enemy will always have them all employed. Your team may or may not.  It was the only way to balance out multiplayer/single player..and not have a bunch of the same hero running around.
As for the deathregion...thats on purpose. Keeps troops from all ending up in the ships and cant fly out.

posts.content_text:
Features:
- Jedi vs Clones: Order 66 style gameplay.
- Massive battle. There will be about 90 clones and 50 jedi on the field at the same time. The clones will have a reinforcement count of 350 and the jedi will have one of 200.
- The jedi will have clone commandos to help them.
- Custom hero for the jedi. Featuring small skin modification and combo modification.
- You start with a basic Jedi Padawan and you need points to unlock the commandos and better jedi units. 5 points for the Jedi Knight and Jedi Protector, 12 for the commandos and 25 for the Jedi Master.
- Due to "technical difficulties", the imperials lost their starting AT-TE". Another one will come to aid the imperials 3 minutes after the beginning of the battle. You can see how much time is remaining thanks to a small timer under the minimap.
- Imperial recolor for the AT-TE and the Forward Command Center. I just replaced the red in the skins with gray.
- The jedi have the Rebel voiceovers.
Currently working on:
- Need commandos. Currently have modified EP2 marine as placeholder. A good choice is Vyse's commando model, but it could use a better skin.
- The imperial hero is going to be a surprise, and will appear in a later version. Current placeholder is Darth Vader.
- Various junk.
- Good suggestions are welcome.
Screenshots:
Link:
http://files.filefront.com/Snowy_Valley ... einfo.html
Alternate Link:
http://www.savefile.com/files.php?fid=2446240

Played it, and I thought it was a pretty fun map. Though, I do have a few suggestions...
- First thing I noticed off the bat was that Saesee Tiin's and Grievous' lightsabers were untextured. I'm not sure if you knew this or not, but I'm just pointing it out to you. The sabers were just white and untextured. And, of course, Tiin's skin isn't finished, but I know you're still working on that.
- One main thing I saw when I first started out, was that practically none of the CIS actually spawned on top of the ship. They all spawned inside. There was really no fighting whatsoever unless I actually went into their hangar. And even then they just seemed to stand around. The clones were just kinda floating there too... not really doing anything. I don't know if it was like that for you, but the bot pathing was just... well, it needs a lot of work.
- One thing I would suggest that I know you were debating over, is to tone down Tiin's crush move. It's a
little
too powerful. I can literally kill anything I want within an instant. I'd say weaken it just enough so as it won't instantly kill everything, but can still do a fair amount of damage to the critical systems.
- I didn't hear any sounds for the lightsaber or jet packs. You might want to look into that also.
- Last suggestion I have, is to add some ships and lasers flying around in the sky, just to give it some ambience. Right now, the battle just seems kind of... empty. Adding the stuff in the sky would help it feel more like a battle.
* Also, I should note that I noticed all of this while playing as Tiin. I haven't played with the clones or any of the CIS units yet. I'm not sure if the map is different or not while playing as them. Maybe it's just because I was playing as Tiin, I don't know. One thing I did notice was that there was also a couple duplicates of him running around the map. I'd make it so only 1 Tiin can be on the field at one time. That would stop the duplicates and such. I'll go play as a clone and see how it is then. It might be different. I'll get back to you on it.
Overall, it was a good map. Needs work, but, of course, it's only a beta. I'm sure future versions will be even better. This is quite an ambitious map to try, but so far you've done a pretty good job on it. Keep up the good work.

posts.author: Post
posts.content_text:
Definitely an improvement from the first version, but still some things I want to address:
- First thing I want to say, is we need more action. Lasers, explosions, etc. Capital ships in the sky. All that good stuff. Make it feel like you're really in the middle of the Battle of Coruscant. I'd suggest looking in the Felucia sky or something. I recall there being capital ships and lasers effects in the sky. That would definitely help.
- Now, I can understand why you increased the jet pack speed from before, since it used to take forever to get anywhere with them, but now I think they're just a
bit
to fast. They're kinda hard to control, and half the time, I can't even hit a droid/clone flying around in the air without him zipping all over the place. I'd say decrease it, but not so much that it's going to go too slow for you to be able to get anywhere.
- Of course, Tiin's skin isn't finished yet. Hopefully you can get to that soon. I can't wait to see the finished skin. Looks good so far, it just needs more detail. And, while still on the subject of skins, lightsabers still aren't textured.
- The Grievous bomber is of course too strong, as many people have pointed out. I say increase the speed, keep the primary lasers (the rapid-firing yellow ones), and replace the never-ending bombs with the Tri-Fighter's missles, so as you can't take out the Republic capital ship in seconds.
Also, I noticed that it basically has unlimited stamina... so you can like, speed forever. I'd say limit the stamina just a bit.
- I also think Tiin's Force Crush is still too strong also.
- Jetpacks and sabers still have no sound. Read Rends' sound tutorial. That might help bring them back their sounds.
- And the mini CIS capital ships scattered around the map (most notably the one sticking in the damaged Republic capital ship)... those are meant to be used in the sky dome. They don't really look good close up. I'd suggest adding more Droid Control Ships and frigates to fill in the spaces. Maybe even another CIS capital ship (just as a prop, of course). Then you can have more capital ships and such in the sky dome, moving around.
And I think that's basically it. Other than that, the map was great. Hope it doesn't seem like I'm being really tough on this map, I'm just trying to help point out the problems so you can fix 'em and get this map as good as you can get it.

posts.author: Post
posts.content_text: I will do my best with adding more ships but I already thing the filesize is too big. It takes about an hour to upload the file for everyone. 1. When you first download the file, it should be a zip file named "tav".
Extract everything in the file to your desktop.
2. You should have extracted 3 files. One of them should be a readme text file named "Read Me"
and the other two should be zip files named "TAV_Part_I" and "TAV_Part_II".
3. Extract everything from the zip file named "TAV_Part_I" to the desktop. You should have
extracted a folder named "TAV".
4. Move the "TAV" Folder to your Star Wars Battlefront II Addon folder in
Program Files/LucasArts/Star Wars Battlefront II/GameData/AddOn.
5. Now, extract everything from the zip file named "TAV_Part_II".
You should have extracted 3 folders named "FPM", "SIDE", and "Sound."
6. Move these three folders named "FPM", "SIDE", and "Sound" to the LVL_PC Folder in
the "TAV" Folder that you just put in the AddOn folder. The location of the LVL_PC Folder
is here. Program Files\LucasArts\Star Wars Battlefront II\GameData\Addon\TAV\data\_LVL_PC
As you can see it's located in another folder named "data". Once you've put all 3 folders
into the LVL_PC Folder it should work.

posts.author: PvtParts
posts.content_text:
Blocky laser is his video settings - look at the rest of the his map compared to what you all see on your version..
Love the effects (such as plasma grenade)
Fun map penguin, real fun. I havent played the gcw modes, need to sleep. test em tomorrow, and give you a report. Ill also try to get some screens of any slight issue, even, say, where starfighters crash, so you can look into it.
Loved the new weapons and tweaking, and xl was great fun.
No major bugs, and however you got your flyers to fly (barriers...meh) worked great, rarely saw a crash, except a few times on the little mesas or plateaus you see (about 20 units high, run through entire map)
Perhaps put more of a delay for orbital strike - it seems so sudden. Add a damage radius of about 6 or 8 to give it more splash and seem more powerfull. (so when it hits the ground it damages those around it)
I like the power in it, it wasted an MTT with 2 of its, what, 8, laser beams.
Recon Commando was suprisingly underpowered. His guns are strong, but hes too weak in my opinion. I suggest bumping the health and dropping the speed (i think of arc commandoes being elite and fast, rep commandoes being elite, stronger, but not the kind of sprinting charachter..with all that armour....)
Orbital strike was a favorite, but it would by nice to put it on grenade anims, so it doesnt just pop out. Curious to see how you managed to get it flash. (its probably a command string.."Lightflash     = "1", but oh well you tell me..) (oh dang i cant wait for the source pack).
Jet Trooper is a blast, like the colors, like the shottie, but maybe drop the heat - i dunno it annoys me because the sound is like a beast but you only get 2 shots (well 1). so im ready to tear it up and its like OVERHEATED!.. personal preference i guess but id sure like to see it a little more powerfull.
SBD is kinda akward - having the rocket launcher -- i dunno maybe its me
to fix the magna guards slow sprinting compare it to ...hmm well im pretty sure jango fett has these. Look in jango fetts (or com_hero NOT com_jedi) and look for acceleration or something (it will be commented about how it accelerates default movement) this should fix his slow sprinting.
and maybe give him jedi jump, but put a jump height that prohibits him from jumping any heigher than the first teir of force jump. Magna Guards could jump high, but obviously not through the force.
Hunt crashed. Dont worry i followed your readme word for word. which leads me to believe 2 things; either you messed up your readme (i doubt but hey...gotta cover every base) or it is user specific. I in the past have had certain maps crash. It sure as anything isnt my computer, im confident that its well qualified (overqualified) to run any thing BattleFront 2 (realistically BattleFront 1) can throw at it.
And since Battlefront 2 has gamemodes, the issue, im sure, could be quite similar. All other modes worked fine, just not hunt.
I recommend making the gunships lasers smaller and faster, same damage.
Liked the new weapons, liked em a lot. But in my opinion it would be a good idea to raise the fire rate of the commando dc-17 main rifle and make the laser smaller.
Also perhaps drop the lifetime of the laser for the dc-17 sniper, sometimes when you move it still exists. a few decimal places lower should do the trick. (also i would like if the dc-17 wasnt a 1 round mag..)
And yeah the warm up for the dc-17 still exists not really annoying cause its a beast anyway but just a note.
Hope these help some, or a lot, or a bit.
Ill get some screenshots to make it easier for you to fix them(even though most of them are more suggestive than criticism/bugs)
And once again, nice map (perhaps add the tatooine or geonosis detail texture to your main textures so it looks higher res up close..)
PS. (check you tips for spelling errors. The one with because is mispelled. easy to fix small difference but whatever..)

posts.content_text: Just played this map for the first time this morning...lol, I've had it on my instant action list forever, but I guess I never got around to playing it - and man, I had a blast.  All the lasers flying everywhere, felt so much like SW.  I absolutely loved the Clone commando guy...felt just like playing Republic Commando again.\nAnd when I was playing as CIS, when I was a Magnaguard, I saw another using his staff...I thought, "Wait, why don't I get a staff...that looks so fun"  And then I figured out the staff was the secondary weapon.  Man, you've done such great things in this map.  I also LOVE the clone gunship...so much fun to ride around in that thing, unleashing terror from above.  When I'm a droid and see that scary sight..hehe.  I haven't even gotten close to exploring everything yet...I would agree that it would be nice if you keep Tuskens from capturing CPs - I think they play too large a role in this map, where I'd rather just have to worry about my primary foe.  Of course, sometimes I just don't capture their CPs so that the other side will be harassed.\nAlso(not sure if this is possible), but something I've noticed different from BF1 in ALL BF2 maps...CPs get taken from me too easily(i.e., I'll capture an enemy command post, then a minute later I'll die, and before I can choose my spawn point, that CP will be lost again)...is there any way to change that?  Anyways, awesome map and so much fun to play.

Great work man.
This is a nice start, as you said this is your first map. Nice.
Here are a couple suggestions:
- With the Height tool (in zeroedit) use Blend to smooth out the terrain. Especially at that 1 clone spawn, its really bumpy, which leads me too my next peice of advice
- Dont have them spawn in the bumpy terrain. Make the spawn a bit back, on flat terrain. Its alright if you have to walk over rugged terrain, but its annoying if you have to spawn on it
- Perhaps change the light color to match the ground. The ground is dark red-orange, but the light color is clear. This can be done by editing the .sky file or placing a light ingame and changing its color.
Keep it up, I have more advice, but ill save that till later. For now, just work on what I said above and continue to progress.
Once again, nice work,
Parts

posts.content_text:
Here is my feedback:
Overall, good. I like the setup, but there are one or two points which could be improved on:
- I think spider walkers would be useful here, to counter the AT-TE's. They would also add a whole new dimension to the game, as I just love seeing those things in the distance frying everyone who tries to attack them.
- You defintely need less troops on the field at any one time. A challenge is one thing, but even as Obi-Wan I found it virtually impossible to stay alive for more than a minute. Plus, it looks kind of sloppy when there are just troops all over the place.
- I think you should stick to the engineer having the shotugn and the commander having the chaingun, although I do LOVE what you have done with the chaingun. The thing is, the Commander now has a fusion cutter and the engineer hasn't, and that ain't right.
- Possibly (and this is ony a possibly) have some LAAT's spawning from a Venator (or at least a hangar) above the sinkhole? Add in some gunships for the CIS and some turrets and it would give this map a whole enw dimension.
- When you fall, you hit a floor. Now, this is fine for a regular soldier, as you die anyway due to the distance. As a Jedi, however, you don't. And then you're stuck down there. Either lose the floor or (now this would be interesting) do it up to look like the bottom of the Utapau sinkhole and put in a way back up...maybe a series of ledges with which a skilled jedi can force jump from one to the other, making his way back to the fight.
In short, I currently give this map about 7/10, but I think it has the potential to defintely become one of the ultimate BF2 maps.

posts.content_text: A review for when you pin down the source of the crashing:\nBasically, I thought this map is rather well built, but I am encountering a sort of difficulty with the play.  The problem is that it's pretty much impossible to gain any significant amount of ground in this map - as soon as you die you lose whatever ground you just gained, and its difficult just to advance because as soon as you shoot down 10 opponents, another 10 simply arrive and take their place before you can even advance.\nTo solve this problem (this is just an idea) you could perhaps add more command posts so that you can benefit from just having a bit more ground, and have many of those cps spawn vehicles closer to the battle, making it both easier to stay alive and easier to hold ground you have captured.  So there are my thoughts - the gameplay could use improvement although the design is great

posts.author: Post by willinator
posts.content_text: Cleb is absolutely right, you do need to make the arms a little longer. It doesn't look like it, but the average person's armspan, fingertip to fingertip, is about the same measurement as their height. In making the model, figure out how wide the torso is, subtract that from the model's total height, divide that number by two, and that's how long each arm should be.

posts.author: Post by Nedarb7
posts.content_text:
Oh that's easy. I use the rotation (camera) and point select tools the most (if you consider them tools). I use blender for modeling, I only use xsi for enveloping and animating so really the two "tools" I mentioned are the ones I use the most. I am very unfamiliar with XSI.
-EDIT-
However if you wanted info for your own education... here are some useful things in blender:
1 The knife tool (in later versions). Extremely useful for making complex details (such as the visor on the rc)
2 Deleting faces. I tend to do this a lot, you can create better topology by manually creating faces.
3 Merging vertices. Helps when you need to patch up disconnected edges (which make sharp edges)
4 Flipping normals. YES! The model saver when the texture is inverted. :p

title: What makes a map to be called "final"
author: Unknown

posts.author: Post by Rends
posts.content_text:
first i have to say that i like maps finished by the creators. I realy hate maps in beta stage never finished. But then i asked myself what makes a map final.
Well the answer is easy. I compare them with the shipped maps!
Here are some points i check before i call a map "final"
1. Mapname. I like the standart style PLANETNAME: LOCATION. (not required but nice)
2. Flybymovie. Makes it looks more professional (not required but nice)
3. Minimaps. I hate it to get lost (required)
4. Gameplay . The most importand point. Must be fun to play the map. If not or if i get boored soon i trash the map faster than i installed it.
5. Balance. Normaly the fractions should be balanced in medium difficult  settings. But i also like challenges.
6. Object placements. Flying buildings droids or whatever... destroy the feeling very fast to be in a real world and makes the map looks made rushed and never realy tested. I also realy hate stuff in a map wich didn´t belongs to specific locations.
7. Music. there should be ingame music on the map.
8. Vehicle sound. Since we know how to add them all vehicles should have engine and weapon sounds.
9. Enironment Sound.Example: It´s raining but you don´t hear raindrops? It´s stormy but no wind sound?  Sounds unrealistic doesn´t it.
10. Working AI. AI standing around doing nothing AI crowds running against walls or AI don´t use the vehicles. go back and fix your planning!
11. Graphic and environment lights. I hate to play at bright daylight and objects looks yellow like they stand in a battle happening on Geonosis. We have a sticky about the correct sky file usage here at gametost.
12. Localize your map. Oh i hate it also to "watch out for Gamorreans" at the "Throneroom" even if there are no Piggys running around and the CP doesn´t have something to do with the standart named CP1 "Barracks" or CP2 "Thronerroom"
13. Bugs. Crashing maps wich could be fixed very fast if the mapper would test it with SPtest.exe. Ok, it don´t tell you every problem. But some maps are full with hundrets of errors recorded in the log file.
to be continued...
Feel free to critisize or add comments. Now someone may say i don´t know how to do this or that. But hey we have enough stickies here and a board to ask. Psych0fred answered also a couple of question at his own board you can find at the left of this site below links!

Reconand commander units.

Dragon93's
Lava trooper skins :p.

Added Hero assault to the map, with a different CP configuration to tighten up the battle. Jai Maruk is in it as well.

Teancum
can.

Lava Troopers

Extract everything in Mustafar_Valley_2.0.rar to the desktop.

Then extract the contents of SIDE to TST\data\_LVL_PC. There should be a folder in there named SIDE.
Run BF2, and play my map! Enjoy!!
Edit:
The patch for the lava trooper skins is out now!!
Installation:
First backup the rep.lvl nad repshell.lvl, do this by renaming it or moving it to another folder.

posts.author: Post
posts.content_text:
Well I'm back, after several days without an internet connection! I hope I won't lose access to the net again, but I can't be sure I won't...
Anyway, I glad you guys seem to like the mod/script. Having no net connection, I used the time I would have spent browsing on improving the hero script. I've added a few new options (one being the adjustable spawn time for the heroes
), and hopefully I've made it better than before. The new additions add more timers and callbacks to cover the new functionality, so I hope it won't cause a problem on slower systems (it shouldn't, but you never know...).
...and as Epena guessed, I've also updated the AI mod too:
*EDIT: Quicky update, added a spawn location randomizer
http://files.filefront.com/AIHeroSuppor ... einfo.html
I think I'll take the chance and release the script. I imagine it will take a while for anyone to actually release a map that uses it, so if some issue does crop up it is very easy to remove the script, so it wouldn't be a problem for the mapper to do so.
To address some of the issues brought up:
"Immedate hero spawn" - (Fixed) Now the default time is 25 sec, but this can be changed by the mapper from their own script.
"Doesn't work in conquest" - I didn't test the first version of the script in conquest, but I have tested the latest version. It seems to run fine. Try it out and see if it's okay.
"Messes up multiplayer" - I was considering this mod to be in the same class as a "side mod" (messing with the original game files), but if you want me to change it so they are their own entries in the map list, I can do that easliy enough.
"Random spawn location" - I've been thinking about adding this. I just haven't gotten around to it yet.
*EDIT: Quickly added it in (but be warned, it has had only minor testing)
"1 on 1 hero battles" - I'm not sure if you noticed, but one of the "glitches" of this mod is that the hero unit is an "extra" bot on the map. If 16 bots were selected, the hero will be number 17. This is because of the way the game handles character spawning. As near as I can tell, once a character dies a new bot is "queued" for spawn right away. Even if another bot is "force spawned" in, the queued bot will still spawn once their time is up. Unfortunally, I've considered 'zero bots' a special case and I stop the hero spawn in that situation. The script can be told to ignore the bot count if you wish, and will still spawn the heroes even if the bot count is zero, but that is up to the mapper. Do you want me to setup the maps to ignore the bot count?
Is that it, or did I miss something?
*Edit:
"Only effects the original maps, not modded maps" - Yes, because it's a script that the map's lua has to start. I just augmented the original maps to use it.

posts.content_text: If you could setup the maps to ignore the bot count, that would be great. I don't think it would affect gameplay in any other way, would it?

posts.author: Post
posts.content_text:
Hey Wadi! I'm going to have to thank you!
I started looking into your suggestion about the 1-on-1 duels and found a rather big, but not very noticable, bug. Those types of bugs are the worst kind since they can sit there for a long time without ever being discovered.
Well I fixed it (extra testing will verify this), and now as a sort of "side-effect" (it only took a few extra lines of script) the bot count is now correctly managed. If 16 bots were selected, now 16 bots are used (including the hero). The hero is now "reserved" a spot in the roster so if you set a bot count of one (1) the heroes are the only bots on the map. If the hero is taken by the human player, no bots are spawned for that team. Now the 1-on-1 duel is possible.
I would like to get away from the "constant" release of versions as I make minor improvements, but if you guys don't mind 'another' version I'll release it with this fix. Or should I just wait and see if anyone finds something else wrong with the "current" version?

posts.author: Post
posts.content_text:
Ugh, not another Kashyyyk map! But wait, this is my first real "map" as opposed to "map-mod" and I had this really great idea for a wookie-trandoshan brawl.
The wookie side has tons of HP and nice heavy equipment, the trandoshan side has superior numbers and a few cool tricks. You'll find everything from wookie berserkers cutting down trandoshans with their claws to trandoshan scouts sniping while invisable to wookie chieftans with powerful beam rifles to trandoshan slavers with stun-carbines. There's something for everyone.
Placing all those trees and fern clumps was a Diet Dr. Pepper lot of work, as was smoothing out all the terrain, but I like the final effect. However since this is my first real map, I'm sure there's some defect with the terrain that I'll have to correct later.
Sadly, I'm no moddeler and reskins have only worked so-so for the trandoshans, but they still play great.
Download:
http://files.filefront.com/KSK_TRzip/;5 ... einfo.html
Screens:
Readme:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Description:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
KashyyyK: Trandoshan Raid
Another raiding party of Trandoshan slavers has landed near an isolated group of villages on Kashyyyk; both sides race to take control of the fortified wookie villages that will determine the outcome of the ensuing battle.
The Trandoshan's consist of:
Trandoshan Warrior: Carries a blaster rifle, pistol and grenades, pretty standard.
Trandoshan Grenadier: Carries lots of grenades, a pistol and a Concussion rifle (think souped-up emp-launcher)
Trandoshan Slaver: Carries a stun carbine (think long-range arccaster) and a fusion cutter.
Trandoshan Hunter: Carries a sniper rifle and a pistol as well as detpacks, but he has stealth and it's an off-hand weapon, so he can use it and still have a rifle equiped to shoot, though it flickers a bit more than the bothan version.
Trandoshan Leader: Carries a heavy pistol (very powerful, lousy rate of fire) and can shield his allies.
Trandoshan Heavy Trooper: Carries a chaingun, a pistol and grenades.
The Wookies are optimised for close-range work;
Wookie Warrior: Has a bowcaster and grenades, nice and conventional.
Wookie Commando: Carries a shotgun, a commando pistol and grenades.
Wookie Rocketeer: Is equiped with a missile launcher, pistol and grenades.
Wookie Engineer: Carries a grenade launcher with lots of ammo, time bombs and a fusion cutter.
Wookie Chieftan: Carries a wookie Beam rifle (think princess leia's pistol with no zooming but lots of firepower).
Wookie Berserker: This crazed Diet Dr. Pepper only uses his claws.
The map is fairly large, there are four villages plus the Trandoshan landing site as objectives. The Trandoshans have a large numbers (units and reinforcements) edge, but wookies are Diet Dr. Pepper hard to take down.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Installation:
Copy the KSK folder into LucasArts/Star Wars Battlefront II/GameData/AddOn/
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Game Modes:
The map only includes conquest and only the Galactic Civil War Era
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Known Issues:
This is my first actual map as opposed to map mod, so there's probably still a tree sticking in the air somewhere.
The wookie commando was orginially supposed to carry detpacks, but I'm still missing a file somewhere.
It's another Kashyyyk map.
The Trandoshans are borderline ugly, you can only take re-textures so far, I need trandoshan models.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Contact:
Leave feedback at
Crichton6@yahoo.com
.

-Unarchive to desktop.
-Open folder "KotORGC"
-Move folder "GameData" into your "Star Wars Battlefront II" folder
(usually C:Program FilesLucasartsStar Wars Battlefront II)
-Allow files to be overwritten (nothing is actually overwritten)
To resume, :
1- Install the ConvoPack 2.0 and the UnOfficial 1.3 patch
2- Extract the KotOrGC folder
3-Move the "GameData" folder into your SWBF2 directory and confirm the file replacement.
And it's done!

So here it is (finally), version 1.0 of Operation: Ferret <out the> Master. I was thinking of going back and adding a whole bunch of extra stuff, but I had to stop and remind myself that this map was supposed to only be a prototype to see what could be done with the game engine. As such, the map may not have a huge selection of modes or custom sides like many other maps, but I believe (and I'm sure most of you will agree) that the unique nature of its gameplay makes up for that. Have fun!
- Short description -
Story-based adventure map that includes some RPG gameplay elements. For the full description, please review the copy of the readme posted below.
- Available modes -
GCW Hunt - OFM Story mode
CW Conquest - Normal Conquest with boosted unit count (2x)
